title: AP Citizen 360° Canonical Data Model — Table-by-Table Reference
description: One JSON object per Iceberg table in ap_citizen360, generated directly from scripts/citizen360_full_model_ddl.sql so the column list/types here can never drift from the live DDL. Every field carries a plain-language description of what it holds and how it's used. Tables are listed in DDL order, grouped under the same section banners as the DDL file.
groups: SECURITY — DATA TRANSFER API DEPARTMENT CLIENT REGISTRY
DATA TRANSFER API — ENTITLEMENTS, TRANSACTIONS, DISBURSEMENTS
DATA TRANSFER API — REQUEST IDEMPOTENCY, EVENT-DELIVERY INDEX, ACK/STATUS PERSISTENCE

dim_state.description: One row per state per effective-dated period (slowly-changing dimension via effective_from/effective_to/is_current) — currently only Andhra Pradesh. Backs the State Profile view and top-of-hierarchy rollups.

households.description: Total household count in the state.

districts_count.description: Number of districts in the state.

mandals_count.description: Number of mandals across all districts.

villages_count.description: Number of villages/habitations across all mandals.

median_age.description: Median age of the population, in years.

gross_state_income_cr.description: Gross state income/product, in INR crores.

avg_monthly_kwh.description: Average monthly electricity consumption per consumer, in kWh.

property_tax_collected.description: Total property tax collected statewide, in INR.

agri_land_acres.description: Total agricultural land extent, in acres.

ration_cards_total.description: Total NFSA ration cards issued statewide.

ration_aay.description: Ration cards under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (poorest-of-poor) category.

ration_phh.description: Ration cards under the Priority Household category.

ration_nphh.description: Ration cards under the Non-Priority Household category.

ration_others.description: Ration cards under other/legacy categories not covered above.

effective_from.description: Start date this snapshot row is valid from (SCD2 versioning).

effective_to.description: End date this snapshot row is valid until; null/open-ended for the current row.

is_current.description: True if this is the latest/active version of the state snapshot.

dim_district.description: One row per district per effective-dated period (slowly-changing dimension), nested under dim_state via state_id. Backs the District Profile drilldown view.

households.description: Total household count in the district.

sex_ratio.description: Females per 1000 males in the district.

urbanization_pct.description: Percentage of the district's population classified urban.

ration_cards_total.description: Total NFSA ration cards issued in the district.

ration_aay.description: District ration cards under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana category.

ration_phh.description: District ration cards under the Priority Household category.

ration_nphh.description: District ration cards under the Non-Priority Household category.

ration_others.description: District ration cards under other/legacy categories.

vehicles.description: Total registered vehicles in the district.

land_acres.description: Total land extent recorded in the district, in acres.

agri_land_acres.description: Total agricultural land extent in the district, in acres.

properties.description: Total registered properties (residential/commercial) in the district.

gas_connections.description: Total registered domestic gas connections in the district.

electricity_consumers.description: Total registered electricity consumer connections in the district.

avg_monthly_kwh.description: Average monthly electricity consumption per consumer, in kWh.

property_tax_coverage.description: Percentage of assessed properties that are current on property tax.

effective_from.description: Start date this snapshot row is valid from (SCD2 versioning).

effective_to.description: End date this snapshot row is valid until; null/open-ended for the current row.

is_current.description: True if this is the latest/active version of the district snapshot.

dim_mandal.description: One row per mandal (sub-district administrative unit), nested under dim_district via district_id. A thin lookup table — aggregate metrics for a mandal are computed on the fly from the fact/dim tables that carry mandal_id, not stored here.

dim_village.description: One row per village/habitation, nested under dim_mandal via mandal_id. Like dim_mandal, a thin lookup table — village-level metrics are computed on the fly from records carrying village_name.

village_name.description: Display name of the village — the value other tables (dim_person, dim_household, ...) actually join on, since they denormalize village_name directly rather than village_id.

dim_person.description: The core citizen record — one row per person. Every other dim_*/fact_* table that describes an individual (vehicles, land, health, education, ...) joins back to this table via person_id. Backs the Citizen 360 profile view and is the default-join target for every Citizen Dimension Data API lookup.

person_id.description: Canonical citizen identifier, persistent across all source updates. Primary source: Citizen Register of Andhra Pradesh (CR-AP); falls back to UIDAI Aadhaar seeding records when no CR-AP record exists.

person_name.description: Full legal name. Primary source: CR-AP; falls back to UIDAI Aadhaar authentication response, then EPDS ration card beneficiary name.

age.description: Current age in years — derived from date_of_birth at query time, not stored as a static value.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth, as registered in the birth certificate or Aadhaar record.

social_category.description: Social category for reservation/welfare purposes — OC / BC / SC / ST / Others.

income_band.description: Household income bracket the person falls into (e.g. 'Below ₹1.5L', '₹1.5L – ₹3L') — used for scheme eligibility filtering.

dwelling_type.description: Housing tenure and construction quality, e.g. 'Own House – Pucca', 'Rented Apartment'.

district_id.description: Foreign key to dim_district.district_id — the person's current district of residence.

mandal_id.description: Foreign key to dim_mandal.mandal_id — the person's current mandal of residence.

village_name.description: The person's current village/habitation of residence (denormalized text, not a village_id FK).

household_id.description: Foreign key to dim_household.household_id — the household this person belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp the canonical row was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp the canonical row was last updated by any source — used for asOf incremental-sync filters.

occupation_type.description: Denormalized 'current' occupation snapshot for fast filtering (e.g. 'Farmer', 'MGNREGA Worker') — full occupation history with concurrent occupations lives in dim_occupation.

occupation_sector.description: Sector of the current occupation, e.g. 'Agriculture', 'Government', 'Private'.

employer_name.description: Name of the current employer, where applicable.

designation.description: Job title/designation in the current occupation.

caste_name.description: Specific caste/sub-caste detail, complementing the broader social_category (OC/BC/SC/ST) classification.
caste_name.value_description: ['Mala', 'Madiga', 'Kapu', 'Reddy', 'Shaik / Sheikh', 'Yadava (Golla)', 'Kamma', 'Settibalija', 'Balija', 'Valmiki Boya (Boya, Bedar, Kirataka, Nishadi, Yellapi, Pedda Boya)', 'Yadava', 'Shaik', 'Vysya', 'Rajaka (Chakali, Vannar)', 'Thurupukapus or Gajulakapus', 'Telaga', 'Turupu kapu', 'Koppulavelama', 'Rajaka', 'Yenadis', ...]

caste_derived_flag.description: True if caste_name was derived/inferred rather than directly certified.

caste_base_certificate_no.description: Certificate number of the underlying caste certificate this record is based on.

door_no.description: Door/house number component of the residential address.

secretariat_code.description: Gram/Ward Sachivalayam administrative unit code — sits between mandal and village/habitation in AP's local-governance hierarchy.

constituency_code.description: Electoral assembly constituency code covering the person's residence.

rural_urban_flag.description: Whether the residence is classified Rural or Urban.

cluster_id.description: Local administrative cluster grouping (sub-mandal), used for some welfare-scheme targeting.

domicile_status.description: True if the person holds confirmed AP domicile status.

marital_status.description: Current marital status. Resolved by latest status_date across sources, with source priority as the tie-breaker on equal dates.

govt_employment_type.description: None | Active Govt Employee | Pensioner | Contractual — distinct from the broader employment_status field, specifically tracking government-sector employment for pension/benefit eligibility.

is_deceased.description: True if a death has been registered for this person — triggers DBT pipeline stoppage and entitlement-closure workflows.

father_person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id for the father, when the father is also a known canonical citizen.

mother_person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id for the mother, when the mother is also a known canonical citizen.

husband_name.description: Husband's name, where applicable (e.g. for widow-pension eligibility checks).

husband_person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id for the husband, when the husband is also a known canonical citizen.

dim_household.description: One row per household — the family/ration-card unit that dim_person.household_id and dim_family_member.household_id join against. Carries household-level (not individual-level) attributes like ration card and income category.

head_person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id for the head of household.

head_name.description: Name of the head of household (denormalized for display without a join).

head_gender.description: Gender of the head of household.

members_count.description: Total number of members in the household.

social_category.description: Household-level social category (typically the head's), used for some household-targeted welfare schemes.

ration_card_no.description: NFSA ration card number issued to this household.

ration_card_type.description: AAY / PHH / NPHH — ration card priority category.

latitude.description: Geocoded latitude of the household's residence, where available.

longitude.description: Geocoded longitude of the household's residence, where available.

pincode.description: Postal PIN code of the household's residence.

dwelling_type.description: Household-level housing tenure/quality, e.g. 'Own House – Pucca'.

phone.description: Primary contact number for the household.

household_income_category.description: BPL / APL classification — distinct from the ranged income_band, used by schemes that key specifically on Below/Above Poverty Line status rather than an income range.

updated_at.description: Timestamp the household record was last updated by any source.

dim_family_member.description: One row per other household member as recorded against a primary person_id's household — used to show a citizen's family composition without requiring every relative to themselves be a fully resolved dim_person row (handles cases where a household member's own person_id record doesn't exist or isn't linked yet).

family_member_id.description: Canonical identifier for this family-member record.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the citizen whose profile this family member is listed under.

relation.description: Relationship to the primary person_id, e.g. 'Spouse', 'Son', 'Daughter'.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this family-member record was last updated.

dim_citizen_identifier.description: One row per government-issued identifier held by a person (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License, Bank Account, ...) — a person can hold multiple identifiers of different types, and dim_person itself stores none of them directly.

identifier_value.description: The identifier's value/number itself (PII — masked in most API responses).

is_primary.description: True if this is the person's primary identifier of this type, when more than one of the same type is on file.

issuing_authority.description: Authority that issued the identifier, e.g. 'UIDAI', 'Election Commission of AP'.

expiry_date.description: Expiry date of the identifier, where applicable (e.g. driving licenses).

is_active.description: True if the identifier is currently active/valid (not cancelled or superseded).

verified_flag.description: True if the identifier has been verified against its issuing authority's system (e.g. Aadhaar e-KYC verified), distinct from merely being on file.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this identifier record was last updated.

dim_consent.description: One row per data-sharing consent grant a citizen has given — backs purpose-limitation checks before citizen data is released to a requesting department via the Data Transfer API.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — whose data this consent covers.

allowed_purposes.description: Array of purpose codes this consent permits (e.g. 'SCHEME_ELIGIBILITY_CHECK', 'AUDIT') — must include the purpose a Data Transfer request declares, or the request is denied.

valid_to.description: Date this consent expires, if not revoked earlier.

is_revocable.description: True if the citizen can revoke this consent before its valid_to date.

created_at.description: Timestamp the consent was originally granted.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp the consent was revoked, if applicable; null if still active.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this consent record was last updated.

dim_tax_profile.description: One row per person summarizing income-tax and GST liability — distinct from dim_property_tax, which covers municipal property tax rather than income/GST.

income_tax_paid.description: True if the person has a record of having paid income tax in the relevant assessment period.

gst_paid_annual.description: Annual GST paid by the person (e.g. as a registered business owner), in INR.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this tax profile was last updated.

dim_occupation.description: Full occupation HISTORY — one row per person per occupation, since a citizen can hold more than one concurrently (e.g. farmer + seasonal MGNREGA labourer). dim_person.occupation_type remains a denormalized 'current' snapshot for fast filtering; this table is the source of truth for the complete history.

occupation_record_id.description: Canonical identifier for this occupation record.

occupation_type.value_description: ['Student', 'Unemployed', 'SHG member Rural', 'Farmer', 'Agriculture & Allied Activities', 'Senior Citizen', 'Homemaker', 'Minor', 'Pensioner / Retired', 'SHG member Urban', 'Regular- Employee', 'Pensioner', 'Driver', 'Government Employee', 'Auto Driver', 'Professional', 'Business / Retail', 'Skilled Worker', 'Weaver', 'Service Worker', ...]

occupation_sector.description: Sector this occupation falls under, e.g. 'Agriculture', 'Government', 'Private', 'Informal'.

employer_name.description: Employer name for this occupation record, where applicable.

designation.description: Job title/designation for this occupation record.

employment_status.description: Status of this occupation record, e.g. 'Active', 'Seasonal', 'Ended'.

source.description: System/department that reported this occupation record.

occupation_year.description: Year (or year range) this occupation record pertains to.

is_current.description: True if this is the person's currently active occupation among possibly several historical/concurrent records.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this occupation record was last updated.

dim_student.description: One row per person PER education level reached (Primary/Secondary/Intermediate/Polytechnic/Degree/PostGraduate) — so a person's full education history is retrievable, not just their latest/highest level.

student_record_id.description: Canonical identifier for this education-level record.

education_level.description: Normalized education tier this record represents — Primary / Secondary / Intermediate / Polytechnic / Degree / PostGraduate. This is what eligibility filters match against (not highest_qualification).

highest_qualification.description: Free-text specific qualification within this level, e.g. '10th Class', 'B.Tech (CSE)', 'M.Tech' — finer-grained detail than education_level.

institution_id.description: Canonical identifier of the educational institution attended.

institution_code.description: Government-assigned code for the institution (e.g. UDISE code for schools).

education_board.description: Examining board/university for this level, e.g. 'BSEAP', 'AP State Board'.

class_currently_enrolled.description: Class/grade currently enrolled in, for ongoing levels.

academic_year.description: Academic year this record pertains to.

is_current_level.description: True if this is the person's currently active education level among possibly several historical records.

is_dropout.description: True if the person dropped out at this education level without completing it.

dropout_reason.description: Reason recorded for the dropout, where is_dropout is true.
dropout_reason.value_description: ['Class 12 - Passed Out', 'Active for Import/Status Not Known', 'Others Reasons', 'Student absent since many days', 'Gone for Some other Mode of Study/Courses', 'Migrated to Other State', 'Gone for ITI/Polytechnic', 'Gone for Study in Open Schooling / Un-Recognized Schools', 'Migrated to Other Block/District', 'Economic Reason', 'Wrong Entry', 'Gone for Study in Non-Regular Mode', 'Duplicate Entry', 'Due to Death', 'Transportation Difficulties', 'Employment', 'Studying in Other School in Same Block', 'Migrated to Other Country', 'Orphan']

medium_of_instruction.description: Language of instruction at this level, e.g. 'Telugu', 'English'.

aadhaar_seeded.description: True if this education record has been seeded/linked with the person's Aadhaar.

has_apaar_id.description: True if the student has been issued an APAAR (Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry) ID.

apaar_id.description: The student's APAAR ID, when has_apaar_id is true.

student_id.description: School/institution-issued student roll number or ID.

aposs_id.description: Andhra Pradesh Open School Society enrollment ID, for open-schooling students.

epass_id.description: AP ePass scholarship portal enrollment ID.

epass_amount.description: Scholarship amount disbursed via AP ePass for this education level, in INR.

thalliki_vandanam.description: True if this education level's enrollment qualified the family for the Thalliki Vandanam scheme (cash support to mothers for sending children to school).

ntr_vidya_deevena.description: True if this education level's enrollment qualified for the NTR Vidya Deevena fee-reimbursement scheme.

pre_matric_scholarship.description: True if a pre-matriculation scholarship was received for this level.

post_matric_scholarship.description: True if a post-matriculation scholarship was received for this level.

digital_literacy_level.description: Self-assessed/tested digital literacy at this education level — None / Basic / Intermediate / Advanced.

scholarship_scheme_ids.description: Array of dim_scheme.scheme_id values for every scholarship scheme linked to this education-level record.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this education record was last updated.

dim_vehicle.description: One row per vehicle owned — identity/registration details. Compliance/regulatory status (insurance, fitness, permits, challans) is split out into dim_vehicle_compliance to keep slow-changing compliance data separate from largely-static identity data.

dim_vehicle_compliance.description: One row per vehicle's regulatory/compliance status — insurance, fitness, permits, taxes, loans, challans. Keyed by (person_id, reg_no) back to the owning dim_vehicle row, kept separate because this data changes far more often than vehicle identity.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the vehicle owner.

reg_no.description: Vehicle registration number — joins back to dim_vehicle.reg_no.

insurance_valid_to.description: Date the current insurance policy expires.

fitness_valid_to.description: Date the vehicle's fitness certificate expires.

registration_valid_to.description: Date the vehicle's registration itself expires/needs renewal.

puc_valid_to.description: Date the Pollution Under Control certificate expires.

permit_type.description: Type of transport permit held, where applicable (e.g. commercial vehicles).

tax_paid_upto.description: Date through which road tax has been paid.

green_tax_due.description: True if a green tax (for older vehicles) is currently due.

financer_name.description: Name of the financing bank/NBFC, if the vehicle is under loan.

hypothecation_status.description: Hypothecation (loan lien) status with the financer, e.g. 'Active', 'Terminated'.

loan_outstanding.description: Outstanding loan amount against the vehicle, in INR.

hsrp_issued.description: True if a High Security Registration Plate has been issued for this vehicle.

challan_pending.description: True if there is at least one unpaid traffic challan against this vehicle.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this compliance record was last updated.

dim_land.description: One row per land parcel owned — agricultural, residential, or commercial. Carries revenue-record detail (survey numbers, registration, mutation) as well as agronomic detail (soil, irrigation) for parcels used for farming.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the owner.

land_type.description: Agricultural / Residential / Commercial classification of the parcel.

land_classification.description: Revenue classification of the land, e.g. 'Wet', 'Dry', 'Garden'.

sub_survey_no.description: Sub-division of the survey number, where the parcel is a subdivided plot.

irrigation_type.description: Irrigation source/type for the parcel, e.g. 'Canal', 'Borewell', 'Rain-fed'.

extent_dry_land.description: Portion of the parcel's extent classified as dry (unirrigated) land, in acres.

dim_property.description: One row per built property owned — residential, commercial, or apartment units. Municipal tax status for each property lives separately in dim_property_tax, joined via ptin.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the owner.

ward_no.description: Municipal ward number the property falls under.

block_no.description: Block number, in layouts organized by block.

street_name.description: Street name of the property's address.

area_sq_ft.description: Total area of the property, in square feet.

site_area_sq_ft.description: Underlying site/plot area, in square feet.

usage_type.description: Residential / Commercial usage classification for tax/zoning purposes.

registration_no.description: Deed registration number for the property.

registration_date.description: Date the property deed was registered.

market_value.description: Estimated market value of the property, in INR.

guideline_value.description: Government guideline (registration) value of the property, in INR.

ptin.description: Property Tax Identification Number — joins to dim_property_tax.ptin.

municipal_no.description: Municipal assessment/door number assigned by the local body.

municipal_body.description: Name of the municipal corporation/council/panchayat administering the property.

sro_office.description: Sub-Registrar Office where the property deed is registered.

owner_name.description: Registered owner's name (denormalized for display without a join to dim_person).

plinth_area_units.description: Unit of measure used for plinth area in source records, e.g. 'sq.ft', 'sq.m'.

site_extent_units.description: Unit of measure used for site extent in source records.

dim_property_tax.description: One row per property per assessment year — municipal property tax demand, dues, and payment status. Joins back to dim_property via ptin.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the property owner liable for the tax.

ptin.description: Property Tax Identification Number — joins to dim_property.ptin.

assessment_year.description: Financial/assessment year this tax record covers.

annual_demand_rs.description: Annual property tax demand for this assessment year, in INR.

arrears_rs.description: Arrears carried over from prior assessment years, in INR.

total_due_rs.description: Total amount currently due (demand + arrears − paid), in INR.

amount_paid_rs.description: Amount paid against this assessment year's demand, in INR.

last_paid_date.description: Date of the most recent payment.

payment_mode.description: Mode of the most recent payment, e.g. 'Online', 'Counter'.

exemption_category.description: Exemption category applied, if the property qualifies for a tax exemption/concession.

municipal_body.description: Municipal body that raised this assessment.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department.department_id — the municipal/revenue department owning this tax record.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this tax record was last updated.

dim_health_profile.description: One row per person summarizing their health-system identifiers, chronic conditions, maternal-health status, and government health-scheme coverage. The aggregation point for everything the Health department tracks about a citizen.

abdm_id.description: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission health ID.

abha_address.description: Ayushman Bharat Health Account address (the ABDM health-ID's human-readable handle).

aarogyasri_card_no.description: NTR Vaidya Seva (Aarogyasri) health insurance card number.

aarogyasri_status.description: Enrollment status under Aarogyasri, e.g. 'Active', 'Not Enrolled'.

pmjay_family_id.description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY family unit ID.

height_cm.description: Height in centimetres, from the most recent recorded measurement.

weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms, from the most recent recorded measurement.

bmi.description: Body mass index, computed from the most recent height/weight.

conditions.description: Array of free-text chronic conditions/diagnoses on file, beyond the specific boolean flags below.

has_tuberculosis.description: True if diagnosed with active or treated tuberculosis.

has_hiv.description: True if HIV-positive per health records.

has_cancer.description: True if diagnosed with cancer (any type).

registered_phc.description: Primary Health Centre the person is registered with.

assigned_asha_worker.description: Name/ID of the assigned ASHA (community health) worker.

is_pregnant.description: True if currently pregnant per the latest ANC record.

lmp_date.description: Last menstrual period date, for current/recent pregnancies.

edd_date.description: Expected date of delivery, for current pregnancies.

anc_registrations.description: Count of antenatal care check-up registrations for the current/most recent pregnancy.

institutional_delivery.description: True if the most recent delivery took place in a healthcare institution rather than at home.

covid_vaccinated.description: True if the person has received at least one COVID-19 vaccine dose.

covid_doses.description: Total number of COVID-19 vaccine doses received.

esi_covered.description: True if covered under Employee State Insurance.

cghs_covered.description: True if covered under the Central Government Health Scheme.

rsby_covered.description: True if covered under the Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana.

has_mental_health_condition.description: True if a mental health condition is on file.

mental_health_type.description: Type of mental health condition, where has_mental_health_condition is true.

last_encounter_date.description: Date of the most recent recorded healthcare encounter of any kind.

linked_scheme_ids.description: Array of dim_scheme.scheme_id values for every health-related welfare scheme this person is linked to.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department.department_id — the Health department record owner.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this health profile was last updated.

dim_agriculture_profile.description: One row per person who is a registered farmer — landholding summary, crop information, irrigation, credit, and agricultural welfare-scheme enrollment. Complements dim_land (which records individual parcels) with a farmer-level rollup and scheme/credit detail land records don't carry.

total_land_acres.description: Total land held by the farmer, in acres (across all parcels).

irrigated_land_acres.description: Portion of total land that is irrigated, in acres.

dry_land_acres.description: Portion of total land that is unirrigated (dry), in acres.

primary_crop.value_description: ['Paddy', 'Red gram', 'Cotton', 'Mango', 'Coconut', 'Maize', 'Cashew nut', 'Red Chillies', 'Groundnut', 'Oil Palm', 'Tomato', 'casuarina', 'Sweet Orange', 'subabul', 'Turmeric', 'Banana', 'Onion', 'Ragi', 'Super napier grass', 'Eucalyptus', ...]

secondary_crop.value_description: ['Paddy', 'Red gram', 'Cotton', 'Mango', 'Coconut', 'Maize', 'Cashew nut', 'Red Chillies', 'Groundnut', 'Oil Palm', 'Tomato', 'casuarina', 'Sweet Orange', 'subabul', 'Turmeric', 'Banana', 'Onion', 'Ragi', 'Super napier grass', 'Eucalyptus', ...]

crop_season.description: Cropping season this record reflects, e.g. 'Kharif', 'Rabi'.

crop_types.description: Array of all crop types grown by this farmer across seasons/parcels.

land_reg_nos.description: Array of land registration numbers (cross-referencing dim_land.registration_no) held by this farmer.

soil_health_card_no.description: Soil Health Card scheme registration number.

pump_set_hp.description: Horsepower of the farmer's irrigation pump set, where applicable.

kcc_bank.description: Bank that issued the farmer's Kisan Credit Card.

kcc_limit.description: Sanctioned credit limit on the Kisan Credit Card, in INR.

pm_kisan_beneficiary.description: True if enrolled in the PM-KISAN income-support scheme.

rythu_bharosa_beneficiary.description: True if enrolled in the AP Rythu Bharosa farmer-support scheme.

pmfby_enrolled.description: True if enrolled in the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana crop insurance scheme.

market_linkage.description: Market/procurement channel the farmer is linked to, e.g. a specific mandi or FPO marketing tie-up.

fpo_name.description: Name of the Farmer Producer Organisation the farmer belongs to, if any.

last_yield_qtl_acre.description: Most recent recorded yield, in quintals per acre.

linked_scheme_ids.description: Array of dim_scheme.scheme_id values for every agriculture-related welfare scheme this farmer is linked to.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department.department_id — the Agriculture department record owner.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this agriculture profile was last updated.

dim_crop_sale.description: One row per farmer per financial year — total value of crop sales through tracked procurement/market channels, split paddy vs non-paddy. Used for agricultural income verification.

financial_year.description: Financial year this sales total covers, e.g. '2025-26'.

amt_paddy.description: Total sale value of paddy in this financial year, in INR.

amt_nonpaddy.description: Total sale value of all non-paddy crops in this financial year, in INR.

amt_total.description: Total crop sale value across all crops in this financial year, in INR.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this record was last updated.

dim_social_welfare.description: One row per person summarizing pension, disability, and other Social Welfare department entitlements and self-help-group participation — the aggregation point for everything the Social Welfare department tracks about a citizen, distinct from the broader fact_entitlement table which spans every department's schemes.

pension_id.description: Pension scheme enrollment ID, where the person receives a pension.

pension_type.description: Type of pension received, e.g. 'Old Age Pension', 'Widow Pension', 'Fishermen Pension'.

pension_bank.description: Bank through which the pension is disbursed.

pension_account_no.description: Bank account number the pension is credited to.

is_disabled.description: True if the person has a registered disability.

disability_type.description: Category of disability per RPWD Act 2016 classifications, where is_disabled is true.

bpl_card_no.description: Below Poverty Line card number, where issued separately from the ration card.

secc_family_id.description: Socio Economic Caste Census family identifier.

annual_family_income.description: Annual family income as recorded for welfare-eligibility purposes, in INR.

deepam_beneficiary.description: True if enrolled in the Deepam free-LPG-connection scheme.

bc_welfare_scheme.description: Name of the Backward Classes welfare scheme this person is enrolled in, where applicable.

shg_name.description: Name of the Self-Help Group the person belongs to, if any.

shg_role.description: Role held within the Self-Help Group, e.g. 'Member', 'Leader'.

ntr_bharosa_flag.description: True if enrolled in the NTR Bharosa pension consolidation scheme.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department.department_id — the Social Welfare department record owner.

disability_certificate_date.description: Date the disability certificate was issued.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this social welfare record was last updated.

dim_utility_connection.description: One row per person summarizing their domestic gas, electricity, and water connection status.

gas_connection_status.description: Status of the domestic LPG connection, e.g. 'Active', 'Inactive'.

electricity_status.description: Status of the electricity connection, e.g. 'Active', 'Inactive'.

avg_monthly_kwh.description: Average monthly electricity consumption, in kWh.

water_connection_status.description: Status of the piped water connection, e.g. 'Active', 'Inactive'.

electricity_sc_no.description: DISCOM service connection (SC) number for the electricity connection.

discom_name.description: Name of the electricity distribution company (DISCOM) serving this connection.

electricity_status_updated_on.description: Date the electricity connection status was last confirmed/updated by the DISCOM.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this utility record was last updated.

dim_epfo_contribution.description: One row per person summarizing their Employees' Provident Fund Organisation contribution status — for formal-sector employees contributing to EPF/EPS.

employee_contribution.description: Most recent employee-side EPF contribution amount, in INR.

employer_contribution.description: Most recent employer-side EPF contribution amount, in INR.

eps_contribution.description: Most recent Employees' Pension Scheme contribution amount, in INR.

latest_contribution_date.description: Date of the most recent contribution.

secretariat_code.description: Gram/Ward Sachivalayam code associated with the person's registered address.

establishment_id.description: EPFO establishment (employer) code the contributions were made through.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this EPFO record was last updated.

dim_department.description: Canonical government department lookup — the department_id namespace referenced by entitlement, tax, health, agriculture, and social-welfare records to attribute which department owns a piece of citizen data. Distinct from dim_department_client, which is the separate Data Transfer API client-registry namespace (e.g. 'DEPT-SWD-001') used for authentication rather than data ownership.

department_name.description: Full department name, e.g. 'Health, Medical & Family Welfare'.

dim_scheme.description: Canonical welfare/benefit scheme catalog — referenced by fact_entitlement, fact_benefit_transaction, fact_scheme_disbursement, and the linked_scheme_ids arrays on several dim_* tables.

scheme_name.description: Display name of the scheme, e.g. 'Anna NTR', 'PM-Kisan'.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department.department_id — the department administering this scheme.

benefit_type.description: Nature of the benefit, e.g. 'Cash Transfer', 'In-kind', 'Subsidy', 'Insurance'.

dim_department_client.group: SECURITY — DATA TRANSFER API DEPARTMENT CLIENT REGISTRY
dim_department_client.description: Registered Data Transfer API clients — backs the OAuth2 client-credentials grant at POST /auth/token and verify_bearer_token's suspension check. department_id here is a separate registry-style namespace (e.g. 'DEPT-SWD-001') from dim_department's canonical codes, and has no department_name column — readable names for these specific IDs are maintained as a small static lookup in app code, not in the warehouse.

department_id.description: Registered client identifier, e.g. 'DEPT-SWD-001' — presented as the OAuth2 client_id.

client_secret_hash.description: Salted hash of the client's secret credential — the secret itself is never stored.

scopes.description: Array of purpose codes this client is authorized to request, e.g. 'SCHEME_ELIGIBILITY_CHECK', 'AUDIT'.

dimensions.description: Array of citizen-data dimensions this client is authorized to request, e.g. 'PERSON', 'HOUSEHOLD', 'HEALTH'.

is_active.description: True if this client's credentials are currently active; false suspends/revokes API access immediately.

created_at.description: Timestamp this client registration was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this client registration was last updated (e.g. on scope change or suspension).

fact_entitlement.group: DATA TRANSFER API — ENTITLEMENTS, TRANSACTIONS, DISBURSEMENTS
fact_entitlement.description: One row per person-scheme enrollment — whether a citizen is entitled to a given scheme's benefit, and its current status. Partitioned by district_id. The annual_benefit/last_disbursed_date columns summarize the entitlement; itemized payments live in fact_benefit_transaction.

household_id.description: Foreign key to dim_household.household_id, for household-scoped entitlements.

annual_benefit.description: Annualized benefit value of this entitlement, in INR.

last_disbursed_date.description: Date of the most recent disbursement against this entitlement.

enrolled_date.description: Date the person was enrolled into the scheme.

district_id.description: Foreign key to dim_district.district_id — partition key.

fact_benefit_transaction.group: DATA TRANSFER API — ENTITLEMENTS, TRANSACTIONS, DISBURSEMENTS
fact_benefit_transaction.description: One row per individual benefit disbursement transaction against an entitlement — the itemized payment history behind fact_entitlement's summarized last_disbursed_date. Partitioned by month and district for efficient time-range/geo queries.

amount.description: Amount disbursed in this transaction, in INR.

district_id.description: Foreign key to dim_district.district_id — partition key.

fact_scheme_disbursement.group: DATA TRANSFER API — ENTITLEMENTS, TRANSACTIONS, DISBURSEMENTS
fact_scheme_disbursement.description: Pre-aggregated scheme disbursement totals per geography per fiscal year, broken down by social category — backs the Budget Integrity / disbursement dashboards without having to aggregate fact_benefit_transaction at query time. Partitioned by geo_level and fiscal_year.

geo_level.description: Geography level this aggregate is rolled up to, e.g. 'state', 'district', 'mandal'.

geo_id.description: Identifier of the specific geography at geo_level (e.g. a district_id when geo_level='district').

total_crores.description: Total disbursement amount, in INR crores.

beneficiaries.description: Total count of beneficiaries covered by this aggregate.

amount_oc.description: Disbursement amount attributable to OC-category beneficiaries, in INR crores.

amount_bc.description: Disbursement amount attributable to BC-category beneficiaries, in INR crores.

amount_sc.description: Disbursement amount attributable to SC-category beneficiaries, in INR crores.

amount_st.description: Disbursement amount attributable to ST-category beneficiaries, in INR crores.

amount_others.description: Disbursement amount attributable to beneficiaries outside the OC/BC/SC/ST categories, in INR crores.

fact_event_details.description: The single unified events table — every row is either a LIFECYCLE_EVENT (e.g. BirthRegistered, DeathRegistered, SchemeEnrolled) or an ANOMALY_EVENT (e.g. DualLoanHousehold, PregnancyMismatch), distinguished by event_type with the specific sub-type in sub_event_type. Backs POST /datatransfer/request and GET /api/v1/events/*, and is department_id-scoped so each department only ever sees events routed to it. Replaces the older fact_lifecycle_event/fact_anomaly_event tables, which are no longer queried anywhere. Partitioned by month and district.

person_id.description: Foreign key to dim_person.person_id — the citizen this event concerns.

citizen_name.description: Citizen's name, denormalized for display without a join.

sub_event_type.description: Specific event type within the category, e.g. 'DeathRegistered' (lifecycle) or 'DualLoanHousehold' (anomaly).

severity.description: Severity rating for anomaly events ('High'/'Medium'/'Low'); null for lifecycle events, which don't carry a severity dimension.

detected_at.description: Timestamp the event was detected/occurred — partition key (by month).

district_id.description: Foreign key to dim_district.district_id — partition key.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the event.

resolution_status.description: Current status — lifecycle events use 'Published'/'Processing'/'Failed'; anomaly events use 'Open'/'Under Review'/'Resolved'.

household_id.description: Foreign key to dim_household.household_id, where the event is household-scoped (e.g. DualLoanHousehold anomalies).

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department_client.department_id — the department this event is routed to/owned by.

eventdata.description: Base64-encoded JSON blob of event-type-specific structured detail — e.g. for DualLoanHousehold/PregnancyMismatch anomalies, the per-event loans[]/pregnancyRecords[] arrays are folded in here rather than joined from separate tables.

linked_scheme_ids.description: Comma-separated dim_scheme.scheme_id values linked to this event (e.g. schemes affected by a DeathRegistered event's entitlement closure).

fact_event_request_registry.group: DATA TRANSFER API — REQUEST IDEMPOTENCY, EVENT-DELIVERY INDEX, ACK/STATUS PERSISTENCE
fact_event_request_registry.description: One row per POST /datatransfer/request call — backs idempotency: a reused request_id with a different payload_hash is rejected with 409 CONFLICT, while a reused request_id with the same hash safely replays the original response.

request_id.description: Client-supplied idempotency key from the request payload.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the original request payload — compared against replays of the same request_id to detect a conflicting reuse.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department_client.department_id — the calling department.

event_correlation_ids.description: Comma-separated correlation IDs generated for the events delivered in response to this request.

payload_json.description: The original request payload, stored verbatim for replay/audit.

created_at.description: Timestamp this request was first registered.

fact_event_index.group: DATA TRANSFER API — REQUEST IDEMPOTENCY, EVENT-DELIVERY INDEX, ACK/STATUS PERSISTENCE
fact_event_index.description: One row per delivered event correlation ID, recording which department it was actually sent to — lets on_request/event_status reject an acknowledgement or status update for an event that was never sent to the calling department (404/403), independent of fact_event_details' own department_id routing.

event_correlation_id.description: Canonical correlation ID assigned to a delivered event.

request_id.description: Foreign key to fact_event_request_registry.request_id — the request this event was delivered in response to.

created_at.description: Timestamp this delivery record was created.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department_client.department_id — the department this event's correlation ID was actually delivered to.

fact_event_acknowledgement.group: DATA TRANSFER API — REQUEST IDEMPOTENCY, EVENT-DELIVERY INDEX, ACK/STATUS PERSISTENCE
fact_event_acknowledgement.description: One row per POST /datatransfer/on_request acknowledgement received from a department, confirming receipt of a previously delivered request/event batch.

original_request_id.description: Foreign key to fact_event_request_registry.request_id — the request being acknowledged.

department_id.description: Foreign key to dim_department_client.department_id — the acknowledging department.

acknowledged_at.description: Timestamp the department reported as having received the request.

payload_json.description: The acknowledgement payload, stored verbatim for audit.

fact_event_status_update.group: DATA TRANSFER API — REQUEST IDEMPOTENCY, EVENT-DELIVERY INDEX, ACK/STATUS PERSISTENCE
fact_event_status_update.description: Append-only log of POST /datatransfer/event_status updates — what processing status a department reports back for a specific delivered event over time (e.g. a department reporting it has actioned a lifecycle event).

event_correlation_id.description: Foreign key to fact_event_index.event_correlation_id — the event this status update concerns.

processing_status.description: Status the department is reporting, e.g. 'Received', 'Processed', 'Rejected'.

department_reference_id.description: The department's own internal reference/ticket ID for its handling of this event.

updated_at.description: Timestamp this status update was reported.

remarks.description: Free-text remarks accompanying the status update.

source.description: System/integration that submitted this status update on the department's behalf.

created_at.description: Timestamp this status-update row was recorded.

dim_p4_kpi.description: Canonical catalog of P4/Bangaru Kutumbam KPIs — the indicators rolled up into the five thematic scores (health & nutrition, education, agriculture & livelihood, financial inclusion, infrastructure & living) used throughout the P4 scoring system. KPI forecasts are computed on the fly from this and the score facts below — there is no stored forecast table.

thematic_area.description: Which of the five P4 thematic areas this KPI belongs to.

area_weightage.description: Weight this thematic area contributes to the overall composite score (0-1).

description.description: Explanation of what this KPI measures and how.

unit.description: Unit of measure for the KPI's value, e.g. '%', 'per 1000'.

target_value.description: Target value policy aims to reach for this KPI.

is_inverse.description: True if lower values are better for this KPI (e.g. a mortality rate), so achievement % is computed inversely against the target.

fact_p4_citizen_score.description: One row per person per scoring period — their individual P4 scores across the five thematic areas plus a composite score, and whether they're flagged as part of the Bangaru Kutumbam (uplift-priority household) cohort.

village_name.description: Village this score record pertains to.

period.description: Scoring period this row covers, e.g. a year-month.

is_bangaru_kutumbam.description: True if this person's household is flagged as a priority-uplift (Bangaru Kutumbam) household for this period.

health_nutrition_score.description: Health & Nutrition thematic score for this period.

education_score.description: Education thematic score for this period.

agriculture_livelihood_score.description: Agriculture & Livelihood thematic score for this period.

financial_inclusion_score.description: Financial Inclusion thematic score for this period.

infrastructure_living_score.description: Infrastructure & Living thematic score for this period.

composite_score.description: Weighted composite of the five thematic scores for this period.

upliftment_status.description: Trend classification of this citizen's progress, e.g. 'Improving', 'Stagnant', 'Declining'.

created_at.description: Timestamp this score record was computed/created.

fact_p4_geo_score.description: One row per KPI per geography per period — aggregated KPI achievement at state/district/mandal/village level, backing the P4 geographic dashboards and rankings.

geo_level.description: Geography level this score is aggregated to, e.g. 'state', 'district', 'mandal', 'village'.

geo_id.description: Identifier of the specific geography at geo_level.

current_value.description: Current measured value of the KPI for this geography/period.

target_value.description: Target value for this KPI (denormalized from dim_p4_kpi for this period's comparison).

achievement_pct.description: Achievement percentage against target for this geography/period.

delta_mom.description: Month-over-month change in the KPI's value.

created_at.description: Timestamp this geo-score record was computed/created.

fact_p4_ranking.description: One row per geography per period — composite P4 scores and rank position relative to peer geographies, plus Bangaru Kutumbam uplift progress for that geography. Backs the P4 leaderboard/ranking views.

geo_level.description: Geography level this ranking is computed at, e.g. 'district', 'mandal'.

geo_id.description: Identifier of the specific geography at geo_level.

geo_name.description: Display name of the geography, denormalized for the leaderboard view.

health_nutrition_score.description: Health & Nutrition thematic score for this geography/period.

education_score.description: Education thematic score for this geography/period.

agriculture_livelihood_score.description: Agriculture & Livelihood thematic score for this geography/period.

financial_inclusion_score.description: Financial Inclusion thematic score for this geography/period.

infrastructure_living_score.description: Infrastructure & Living thematic score for this geography/period.

composite_score.description: Weighted composite score used to rank this geography.

rank.description: Current rank position among peer geographies for this period.

previous_rank.description: Rank position in the previous period.

delta_rank.description: Change in rank versus the previous period (positive = improved).

bangaru_kutumbam_total.description: Total count of Bangaru Kutumbam (priority-uplift) households in this geography.

bangaru_kutumbam_uplifted.description: Count of those households that have since been uplifted out of priority status.

upliftment_pct.description: Percentage of Bangaru Kutumbam households uplifted in this geography/period.

created_at.description: Timestamp this ranking record was computed/created.

fact_population_hierarchy.description: Pre-aggregated population pyramid cells — population, household, and ration-card counts broken down by geography, gender, and social category. Backs the Population Hierarchy / demographic pyramid views without aggregating dim_person at query time.

geo_id.description: ap | district_id | mandal_id | village_name — the identifier appropriate to geo_level.

population_count.description: Census population for this geography/gender/category cell.

household_count.description: Number of households headed by this gender/category in this geography.

ration_card_count.description: NFSA ration card holders in this gender/category cell.

fact_population_age_band.description: Pre-aggregated population age-distribution snapshot per geography — backs the population age-pyramid chart.

geo_level.description: Geography level this age-band aggregate covers, e.g. 'state', 'district'.

geo_id.description: Identifier of the specific geography at geo_level.

age_band.description: Age range this row covers, e.g. '0-14', '15-59', '60+'.

percentage.description: Percentage of the geography's population falling in this age band.

snapshot_date.description: Date this age-distribution snapshot was taken/computed.

fact_utility_trend.description: Monthly utility-index trend per geography — electricity, gas, and water indices over time, backing utility-adoption trend charts. Partitioned by geo_level and month.

geo_level.description: Geography level this trend row covers, e.g. 'state', 'district'.

geo_id.description: Identifier of the specific geography at geo_level.

trend_month.description: Month this trend data point covers — partition key.

electricity_index.description: Electricity adoption/consumption index for this geography/month.

gas_index.description: Gas connection adoption index for this geography/month.

water_index.description: Water connection adoption index for this geography/month.
